reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual third-round review of external-03 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 13 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution upper-lip crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; earlier review files were left unchanged

entries.positive_observation: External-03 restores the source's broad dark-brown upper-lip moustache above a single closed mouth while keeping the chin smooth and free of beard. Dark eyebrows remain, with no glasses. The dark olive-black cap retains gold piping/cord, dense gold visor embroidery and two separated front emblems. The near-frontal pose, dark olive uniform, gold shoulder accents, red collar patches with pale/gold detailing and one pale-edged dark throat cross remain. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or clipping. The note retains two upper gray-mark rows, largely blank lower paper and the original dark right-edge tab. The complete dark tilted frame and opaque muted warm grey-olive backing remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette. Actual white/cyan/alpha inspection found no visible holes or missing backing; 252-254 alpha values were not used as a rejection shortcut. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine cap-visor and collar embroidery, the tiny throat-cross detail and note lettering are not reliably readable at source scale. These uncertainties are not rejection reasons; the restored broad moustache, bare chin and two-row note with right-edge tab are directly visible.
